payload.register:
SECOND FILL. Inherits R1-R29 and D1 from the superseded first pass. Two changes and one addition:
1. SOURCE REFS RE-MAPPED. The first pass cited UC-A..UC-D from the first use-case set. That set was superseded; the letters now mean different things, so every citation below points at the CURRENT use cases. An unre-mapped register traces to steps that no longer exist.
2. R8 SHARPENED by what its own implementation got wrong.
3. NINE ADDED (R30-R38), from the three new use cases and the three owner rulings the frame's register predates.

EARS shapes; kind, verify_method and breaks_if_removed on every row.

-- READING AND SEARCHING --

R1 PARTIAL READ (functional). WHEN asked for a line range of a product file, SE SHALL return exactly that range and report the total extent. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a 132k-character file is unreadable through the lane, which is the leading suspect for three design-doc-to-build losses. source: UC-B ext 4a.

R2 OVERSIZE REFUSES, NEVER TRUNCATES (functional, unwanted behaviour). IF a requested read exceeds the response cap, THEN SE SHALL refuse with the actual size and a remedy naming the range parameters. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a silently truncated file reads as a complete one. source: UC-B ext 4a.

R3 MATCHES CARRY CONTEXT (functional). WHEN searching, SE SHALL return each match with its path, line number and a caller-specified number of surrounding lines, IN THE SAME CALL. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a ruling cannot be read around a hit; the measured cost was four calls where one should do. This requirement was once 'satisfied' by a locations-only design plus a decision record explaining why that was acceptable — the record is retired, the requirement was not weakened. source: UC-B step 3.

R4 SEARCH IS FILTERABLE (functional). SE SHALL accept glob and file-type filters, and SHALL offer a list-files-only mode. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: 'where do these files live' degrades to walking directories. source: UC-B step 2.

R5 THE RECORD IS SEARCHABLE (functional). SE SHALL search git refs — tags and branches — not only the working tree. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: since the close-and-merge split withheld iteration evidence from the working tree, NO shipped iteration's evidence is findable. source: UC-B ext 2a.

R6 A FILE IS READABLE AT A REF (functional). SE SHALL read a file's content at a named ref. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the predecessor system and every closed iteration's evidence stay unreadable. source: UC-B ext 2a.

R7 OUTSIDE SOURCES ARE ADDRESSED BY DECLARED NAME (functional). WHERE a source lies outside the repository, SE SHALL address it by a declared name, and SHALL refuse an undeclared root with a remedy that declares it. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: either the lane cannot reach outside sources, or reads become untraceable absolute paths the owner cannot audit. source: UC-B ext 2b.

R8 REQUIRED ARGS ARE ENFORCED, AND ABSENT IS NOT EMPTY (constraint). SE SHALL refuse any call missing a declared required argument and SHALL NOT coerce a missing value; and SE SHALL treat an argument explicitly supplied as empty as PRESENT. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: witnessed twice, once in each direction — a wrong argument name made search look for the literal word 'undefined' and return confident irrelevant hits; then the guard built to stop that refused a legitimate empty value and became the workaround pressure it was built to remove. binding norm: se.law-whitelist-guards. source: UC-E steps 1-3, ext 2a.

R9 CONSULTATION IS LOGGED BY NAME (functional). SE SHALL record every read and search with the source it consulted, naming declared roots and refs rather than absolute paths. verify: test plus inspection. breaks_if_removed: the owner cannot audit a run they did not watch, which se.law-responsibility-never-delegates makes their burden. source: UC-B, UC-J.

R10 NO MATCH IS SAID PLAINLY (functional). WHEN a search matches nothing, SE SHALL say so. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: an empty result is indistinguishable from a broken query. source: UC-B success guarantee.

-- WRITING --

R11 BATCHED EDITS (functional). SE SHALL accept many file edits in one call, each carrying its own guard. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: measured — the patch tool is the most-used product tool at 645 calls and the most-failing at 28, and its absence produced a hand-rolled sweep script. source: UC-C step 1.

R12 A BATCH IS ATOMIC (functional). IF any edit in a batch fails its guard, THEN SE SHALL apply NONE of them and SHALL name which failed and why. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a half-applied batch leaves the tree in a state no hash describes. source: UC-C ext 2a.

R13 THE PRODUCT HAS ONE WRITER (constraint). SE SHALL treat the file lane as the only writer to the product, and SHALL detect and record a product mutation made by any other lane. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the run lane stays an invisible writer — no guard, no diff, no provenance; witnessed when a script rewrote six files with no trace. binding norm: se.law-whitelist-guards. source: draw_context.

-- THE MACHINE JUDGING ITSELF --

R14 GUIDANCE REACHES THE PACKET (functional). WHEN serving a work packet, SE SHALL include every guidance and decision node whose applies_to matches that state, with wikilinks RESOLVED TO CONTENT. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: four laws minted on one afternoon would never reach any packet; an arriving session cannot conform to rules it is never handed. source: UC-H steps 2-4. need: N3.

R15 GUIDANCE VOLUME IS MEASURED (quality: usability). SOURCE an agent receiving a packet. STIMULUS guidance joined from many matching nodes. ARTIFACT the work packet. ENVIRONMENT normal operation. RESPONSE the packet reports its guidance size. MEASURE guidance size present in the packet and reviewable per state. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the join's cost stays invisible until the agent is skimming — a silent failure, since nothing refuses and the rules simply stop being read. source: UC-H ext 4a, se.raid-the-guidance-join-buries-the-instruction.

R16 LINT VERDICTS ARE THE EVIDENCE (functional). WHERE a gate declares a lint for a check, SE SHALL run it and SHALL record its verdict as that field's evidence instead of prompting the agent for prose. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: gates keep asking the agent to vouch for its own work — the mechanism behind ten self-blessed gates and three escaped defects in one prior iteration. source: UC-F steps 2-3. need: N6.

R17 A LINT DECIDES OR DEFERS (constraint). A lint SHALL yield exactly pass, fail, or defer-to-judgement; it SHALL NOT block awaiting input. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: an unattended run stops at 3am for a person who is deliberately absent, inverting the delegation the project is built for. binding norm: se.law-responsibility-never-delegates. source: UC-F ext 2a. need: N7.

R18 LINTS COMPUTE FACTS (constraint). A lint SHALL decide only on facts derivable from the record — files, evidence, run results, ledger edges — and SHALL NOT judge intent or quality. verify: inspection plus test. breaks_if_removed: lints that judge intent refuse correct work, and the agent's rational response is to route around them, replacing 'the tools are too weak' with 'the checks are too dumb'. source: se.raid-a-wrong-lint-becomes-the-new-workaround-pressure.

R19 A FAILING CHECK NAMES THE FACT (functional). WHEN a lint or a guard fails, SE SHALL report the fact that did not hold. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a mechanical refusal without its fact is unarguable and undebuggable. Violated by this iteration's own promotion step, which reported '1 failing' without the name and sent its caller hunting through a green suite. source: UC-F, UC-D ext 4b.

R20 COMPUTED AND ASSERTED ARE DISTINGUISHABLE (functional). SE SHALL record, per gate, which checks were computed and which asserted, readable WITHOUT parsing prose; and a check labelled computed SHALL carry the fact behind it. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the owner cannot tell what a delegated bless rested on — the audit half of se.law-responsibility-never-delegates. An origin label with no fact behind it is worse than none, because it buys trust it has not earned. source: UC-J steps 2-4, ext 3a. need: N9.

R21 THE SCAN IS COLLECTED (functional). WHERE a state's guidance requires a state-of-the-art or prior-art scan, its evidence form SHALL carry a field for it. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: this iteration's own retro finding — the check exists in guidance at this very state, is collected nowhere, and had therefore never once been performed. source: the retro.

-- THE RECORD --

R22 THE GRANT NAMES THE COMMIT (functional). WHEN closing, SE SHALL record the evidence COMMIT HASH in the grant, beside the tag name. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the pointer is a name anyone can delete; a hash reachable from trunk's merge parent cannot be orphaned. source: UC-I ext 2a. need: N8.

R23 TAGS ARE ANNOTATED (functional). SE SHALL create iteration tags as annotated objects carrying the iteration's goal and closing gate. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: verified — push.followTags carries ONLY annotated tags, so the setting every editor user would choose pushes commits and silently drops every iteration tag. source: UC-I ext 3a. need: N8.

R24 THE BRANCH GOES AFTER THE MERGE (functional). WHEN a close merges successfully, SE SHALL delete the iteration branch. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a branch and a tag sharing one name is a ref ambiguity git itself warns about, so ref-scoped record search is unreliable on exactly the refs it must use. source: UC-I ext 2b.

R25 followTags IS CONFIGURED (functional). SE SHALL set push.followTags idempotently for the repository. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a user pushing from the editor UI carries no tags and does not find out. source: UC-I ext 3a.

-- CONFIGURATION --

R26 THE MACHINE-LOCAL CONFIG HAS A LANE (functional). SE SHALL show, set and validate the machine-local configuration, including root paths, the pairing and the brief store. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: witnessed — enabling the brief store needed a hand-rolled script, and the owner asked why the tools were not used; they did not exist. source: draw_context, se.raid-no-lane-for-machine-local-config.

R27 SECRETS STAY MASKED (constraint). SE SHALL NOT return or log a credential value from the config lane. verify: test plus inspection. breaks_if_removed: a credential reaches the record. binding norm: the discipline kept for the notification token.

-- FROM THE PRIOR-ART SCAN, not derived from the use cases --

R28 SUBPROCESS CALLS ARE BOUNDED (constraint). SE SHALL bound every external search process by a timeout and SHALL cap its result count and per-line length. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a pathological pattern or a huge tree hangs the lane or floods the context — the standard failure of shelling out, whose cousin this project already hit with an unbounded transport read.

R29 ROOTS ARE NOT ESCAPABLE (constraint). SE SHALL contain every read and search within the declared root it names, and SHALL refuse a path that escapes it. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a relative escape from a named root reaches the whole disk, turning a named auditable read into an arbitrary one and voiding R9's audit value.

-- ADDED BY THE REWALK: THE REVIEW ITSELF --

R30 EVERY GATE COLLECTS ITS REVIEW (functional). WHEN compiling any gate state, SE SHALL append verify, validate, red-team and verdict to its evidence form as REQUIRED fields, at the single place evidence forms are built. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the whole iteration. The rounds have been required in writing since the method note was authored, no form ever asked for them, and consequently not one had been filled in any gate of any iteration in this project's history — while every one of those gates went green. A rule no form collects is not a weak rule; it is an absent one that reads as present forever. source: UC-A step 2, ext 2a. need: N10.

R31 A REOPEN RE-ACTIVATES WITHOUT ERASING, AND WITHOUT STRANDING (functional). WHEN a verdict is reopen, SE SHALL re-activate the named states and their downstream cone, SHALL mark prior fills superseded rather than delete them, and SHALL leave every downstream join REACHABLE. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the word 'reopen' appeared zero times in the engine while twelve ledger nodes specified it, so the verdict the method demands could not be carried out. The third clause is not decoration: the first live reopen stranded a three-way join and deadlocked the walk silently — no error, no escape, no legal move. source: UC-A ext 6a. need: N11.

R32 A REOPEN LEAVES NO OFFER STANDING (functional). IF a gate's verdict is reopen WHILE an offer for that gate is live, THEN SE SHALL require the offer be dismissed with its reason before the walk continues. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a decision that reviewed badly stays blessable on the board and the phone, and one tap grants what the review refused. source: UC-A ext 6b.

R33 ENGINE CHANGES PROMOTE UNDER DISCIPLINE (functional). WHERE an open iteration changes the engine, SE SHALL promote those files to trunk only IF trunk is current with its upstream and clean in them, the files are engine, binary, test or manifest files only, and the WHOLE suite runs green in TRUNK after the copy and before the commit; and on any failure SE SHALL restore trunk exactly. verify: test plus demonstration. breaks_if_removed: an iteration cannot run the engine it is building — which cost six declared workarounds in one day — and the alternative of a per-worktree engine means two parallel agents are judged by different machines, so a gate stops meaning one thing. source: UC-D. sourced to: the owner's ruling of 2026-07-25, 'let's make engine promotion a real step', and story S3.

R34 A SUITE THAT PROVES NOTHING IS RED (constraint). IF a verification run executes no tests, or finds no test files, THEN SE SHALL treat it as FAILED. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: witnessed in the building of R33 — a suite spawned from inside a test inherits a context variable that makes the runner decline to run anything, reporting zero passed and zero failed. Zero failures reads as green. A gate that runs nothing and calls it proof is the most dangerous state in the system, because it is indistinguishable from success. source: UC-D ext 4c.

R35 AN AMBIGUOUS ROOT REFUSES (constraint). IF more than one iteration is open WHEN a tool must resolve its working root, THEN SE SHALL refuse and name every candidate. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: the tool picks one and writes into the wrong tree silently — and the whole point of the worktree lane is more than one iteration at a time. source: UC-E ext 2b.

R36 IDENTIFIERS ARE EXPANDED WHERE THEY ARE READ (constraint). WHERE an output addressed to a person uses a project identifier, that output SHALL expand it in the same message. verify: inspection. breaks_if_removed: the owner adjudicates from chat and the board, has never seen the evidence files the identifiers live in, and receives a sentence that reads as precision while carrying nothing. Stated by the owner directly. binding norm: brand/voice.md. source: UC-G steps 2-3. NOTE: verify method is inspection, not test — this constrains prose, and claiming a mechanical check for it would be the false-pass R20 exists to prevent.

R37 AN UNATTACHED RULE IS REPORTABLE (functional). WHERE a guidance or decision node declares no state or kind it applies to, SE SHALL report it as unattached. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: a rule that reaches nobody sits in the ledger looking authoritative, and R14 delivers an incomplete set that looks complete. source: UC-H ext 2a.

R38 INTERRUPTION IS RESERVED FOR DECISIONS (constraint). SE SHALL page a person only WHERE it is waiting on their decision, and SHALL NOT page to narrate progress. verify: inspection. breaks_if_removed: the owner's attention is the scarcest resource in an unattended run, and a channel that cries for narration is a channel that gets muted before it carries a gate. Stated by the owner directly. source: UC-G ext 4a.

-- DEMONSTRATION --

D1 (demonstration). The killer sequence SHALL be exercised end to end: in one iteration the agent consults the design document by range, the predecessor system by ref, and a closed iteration's evidence by record search, and writes NO script to do any of it. verify: demonstration. breaks_if_removed: the iteration's central claim goes untested — which is exactly how a prior iteration shipped its unverified leg.

D2 (demonstration). A gate SHALL be shown reviewing itself to a REOPEN verdict, the named states re-walked, and the gate then passing — with the superseded evidence still readable afterwards. verify: demonstration. breaks_if_removed: R30 and R31 are provable in isolation and worthless in isolation; what matters is that the loop closes. ALREADY EXERCISED ONCE, at this iteration's own gate_inputs, and it is what exposed R31's stranding clause.
payload.set_criteria:
PRIOR-ART SCAN ON THE SET — inherited from the first pass, plus a SECOND scan on the area the first pass did not have: a machine that collects its own review. Recording both, including what was missed, rather than presenting the set as if it arrived complete.

FIRST SCAN (inherited, on the tool surface). Scanned against agent-harness read/search conventions, ripgrep's flag surface as a de-facto checklist, and this project's own history. Four misses found and added at the time: result caps and line-length limits, subprocess bounding, path containment, and binary/encoding handling (folded into R28 as an implementation obligation, with the judgement recorded rather than the omission hidden). One miss deliberately not added: a semantic retrieval index — rejected because an index tolerates staleness and this agent reads back what it just wrote.

SECOND SCAN (new, on review collection). QUESTION: what do the standard checklists for technical review demand that this set was missing?
Scanned against: formal review practice (the walkthrough / inspection / audit distinction, and entry-and-exit criteria as the gate's own contract), safety-critical review practice where INDEPENDENCE of the reviewer from the author is the central control, and this project's predecessor system, whose milestone-review rubric is the closest prior art of all — two check sets (the gate's own plus the input cone), 'a bless is not proof', 'cite a rubric not vibes', a named kill-criterion, and an override logged WITH its dissent.

THREE FINDINGS:
- INDEPENDENCE IS THE ONE CONTROL THIS DESIGN CANNOT IMPLEMENT. Every serious review standard separates author from reviewer. Here they are the same actor, and no requirement can fix that. Recorded as the known structural limit rather than papered over, and it is precisely why R16 and R20 matter: what cannot be made independent should at least be made MECHANICAL, and what stays judgement should be labelled as judgement so the owner knows where to spend their attention. This is the honest reason the review rounds are necessary but not sufficient.
- ENTRY CRITERIA ARE MISSING, and I am not adding them. Standard practice gates the review itself: a review does not start until its inputs are ready. Our gates have exit criteria (the acceptance items) and no entry criteria. Judged out of scope for this iteration and recorded as a gap, because adding an entry check to every gate changes the machine's shape rather than its evidence forms.
- THE PREDECESSOR'S RUBRIC IS ADOPTED WHOLE, not reinvented. R30's four fields carry its structure directly, and the specific clauses — a bless is not proof, cite a rubric, name the kill-criterion, log an override with its dissent — are in the injected field descriptions rather than in a note the agent must go and find. That is R14's principle applied to R30.

COMPLETE. Every main step and numbered extension across the ten use cases maps to at least one requirement. All twelve needs are covered: N1→R1/R6/R7, N2→R3, N3→R14/R37, N4→R11/R12, N5→R5/R6, N6→R16, N7→R17, N8→R22/R23, N9→R20, N10→R30, N11→R31, N12→R30 (the red-team field's own description). The three register-orphan stories are sourced explicitly: S3→R33 (owner ruling), S4→R8/R35, S7→R36/R38.

CONSISTENT. One failure philosophy throughout — REFUSE RATHER THAN GUESS: R2 oversize, R8 missing args, R10 no match, R12 atomic batch, R19 the failing fact, R29 escape, R33 promotion, R34 an empty run, R35 an ambiguous root. Two apparent exceptions, both deliberate and both stated: R17's defer is not a guess but an explicit handoff to judgement, and R8's second clause deliberately ACCEPTS an explicitly empty value, because refusing it is what turned the guard into workaround pressure.

AFFORDABLE. One dependency; two new modules (lints, promotion); two new tools; extensions to five existing modules; and DELETIONS — the hand-rolled searcher is gone, so the surface does not only grow. R30 is one function at one place in the compiler, which is why it was affordable enough to land mid-iteration. The costly one is R14, whose join has an unmeasured volume risk that R15 exists to make visible.

BOUNDED. draw_context's binding excluded list holds. Nothing here indexes, judges intent, parks a run, pushes, authors method content, or turns items into nodes. R36 and R38 constrain prose and are honestly marked verify-by-inspection rather than dressed as testable.

NO TBD.

HONEST LIMITS NAMED, three:
1. R16 and R20 assume a gate can DECLARE which checks are lintable, and that M4's element allocation is machine-readable enough for a models-adhered lint. The second half is not yet known; it goes to M5 as a spike rather than being asserted here. If it fails, R16 survives with a smaller lint set.
2. The review rounds constrain FORM, not sincerity. R30 can guarantee a red-team round exists and names a kill-criterion; it cannot guarantee the author looked hard. Logged as se.raid-mandatory-rounds-degrade-into-ceremony, and the only real counterweight is moving checks into R16's mechanical half over time.
3. Reviewer independence is structurally absent, per the scan above. This is the largest single weakness in the set and it is not fixable within this iteration.
